title: Finite branch-aligned Policy-0T trace-to-Resolution bridge
verified_alignment: The deterministic trace branches on variable 4.
The false child returns UNSAT and the proof derives clause (4), which restricts to empty under x4=false.
The true child returns UNSAT and the proof derives clause (-4), which restricts to empty under x4=true.
The final proof line resolves the two sibling conflict clauses on the exact trace branch variable.
consequence: Both ends of the H130 execution-to-proof bridge are mechanically aligned on the first non-affine branching fixture.
next_gate: Replace the hardwired depth-one alignment with a recursive translator that derives a parent conflict clause from every verified child trace and proves global size and depth recurrences.
claim_boundary: This is one finite aligned certificate. It does not prove the uniform Policy-0T simulation lemma, the MAJ3 asymptotic lower bound, P!=NP, or P=NP.
